subject: literacy
concept: Distinguishing fiction from nonfiction, and understanding what each is for
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts book covers/descriptions into 'fiction' and 'nonfiction' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches passages to the correct category based on content clues
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, the difference between a made-up story and a true one

misconception_flags: sorts by topic (animals, space) rather than by fiction/nonfiction status

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
